content: Babel'su sefa'tssia tsa'o
Nane tsendeccu can'jeinteja poiyi'cco a'i tsu fae aya'faveyi afa'je'fa.
Tsomba majan a'i chiga sombo'jene sombopa Sinar andeni japa fae'ngatssia andema atte'fa. Attepa tse'tti can'jen'fa.
Fae a'ta fae'ngae condaseccopa su'fa: “Jinge apichama ladriyove ñoñamba si'ngei'ccu ta'etssia've oque'faya.” Patu me'i'onsi tsesui'ccu tsao'ña'fa. Toya'caen tsu breave an'bian'fa ladriyoma setsaeñe.

Omboe tsu su'fa: “Jinge rande canqqueve canqquiamba ñoa'me se'fatssia tsa'ove'qque tsao'ñañe sefacconi pporotsse. Tsa'caen tsao'ña'ninda tsu poiyi'cco cca'indeccuja ingima in'jan'faya joccapitssia've. Toya'caen tsa'caen tsomba gi biani attufambe'yi fae'ngae can'jen'faya.”
Tsa'ma Na'su Chigaja a'i ñoña'cho canqquema atteye ande. Toya'caen tsu a'i ñoña'cho se'fatssia tsa'oma atteye in'jan.

Attepa Na'su Chigaja asi'ttaen: “Tsendeccuja fae a'iyi tsu. Nane fae aya'fangae tsu afa'je'fa. Tsa'camba fae'ngae in'jamba tsu qquen tsoñe ashaen'fa. Aqquia ashaen'cho tsu. Nane osha'chove in'jan'da tsu tsa'caen tson'faya.
Jinge andepa tise'pa aya'fama ccaningae cambiamba qqueñañe cuintsu poiyi'cco tisupapora ñotsse pañambe'yi can'faye.”
Tsa'caen supa tsu Na'su Chigaja poiyi'cco a'ima attufaemba maña poi andeni. Attufaensi tise'pa canqqueve ñoña'jen'choma antte'fa.

Nane tsa'caen Na'su Chiga tise'pa aya'fama ccaningae cambiansi tsa canqquema inisian'fa Babelve “aya'fa qque'fa'cho” qquen su'chove. Tsene Na'su tise'pama somboensi poi andeni japa cca'tti cca'tti can'jen'fa.
Sem dutssiyendeccu
Qquen tsu Sem dutssiyendeccu: Na'en andema piccopa sambasi dos canqque'fa pasasi Semjan cien canqque'fave an'bian'ni tsu tise dutssi'ye Arfaxadve isu.
Omboe Semjan faesu quiniento canqque'fave can'jemba ti'tsse tsu tsandie, pushesu du'shuve an'bian.
Arfaxadja treinta y cinco canqque'fave an'bian'ni tise dutssi'ye Salave isu.
Omboe Arfaxadja faesu cuatrociento tres canqque'fave can'jemba ti'tsse tsu tsandie, pushesu du'shuve an'bian.
Salaja treinta canqque'fave an'bian'ni tise dutssi'ye Heberve isu.
Omboe Salaja faesu cuatrociento tres canqque'fave can'jemba ti'tsse tsu tsandie, pushesu du'shuve an'bian.
Heberja treinta y cuatro canqque'fave an'bian'ni tise dutssi'ye Pelegve isu.
Omboe Haberja faesu cuatrociento treinta canqque'fave can'jemba ti'tsse tsu tsandie, pushesu du'shuve an'bian.
Pelegja treinta canqque'fave an'bian'ni tise dutssi'ye Reuve isu.
Omboe Pelegja faesu dosciento nueve canqque'fave can'jemba ti'tsse tsu tsandie, pushesu du'shuve an'bian.
Reuja treinta y dos canqque'fave an'bian'ni tise dutssi'ye Serugve isu.
Omboe Reuja faesu dosciento siete canqque'fave can'jemba ti'tsse tsu tsandie, pushesu du'shuve an'bian.
Serugja treinta canqque'fave an'bian'ni tise dutssi'ye Nacorve isu.
Omboe Serugja faesu dosciento canqque'fave can'jemba ti'tsse tsu tsandie, pushesu du'shuve an'bian.
Nacorja veinte y nueve canqque'fave an'bian'ni tise dutssi'ye Taréve isu.
Omboe Nacorja faesu ciento diez y nueve canqque'fave can'jemba ti'tsse tsu tsandie, pushesu du'shuve an'bian.
Taréja setenta canqque'fave an'bian'ni tise dutssiyendeccu Abram, Nacor toya'caen Haránme isu.
Taré dutssiyendeccu
Qquen tsu Taré dutssiyendeccu: Tiseja Abram, Nacor toya'caen Haránmbe yaya. Haránjan Lot quitsa tsu.
Taré toya canse'ni tsu Haránjan pa Caldea ande'su Ur canqqueni. Nane tisuma isu'cho canqqueni tsu pa.
Abramjan Saraima pushe. Nacorja Milcama pushe. Nane Milcaja Harán onque'nge tsu. Harán faesu dutssi'ye tsu Isca.
Saraija du'shuve isuye oshambipa du'shuve me'cco canse.

Taréja Canaán andeni jaye in'jamba Caldea ande'su Urne sombopa ja. Tisei'ccu tsu tise dutssi'ye Abram'qque ja. Toya'caen tsu tise du'shu Lot, tise china Sarai'qque jaja'fa. Canaán andeni jaye in'jan'ma Harán canqqueni nepipa tse'tti can'jen'fa.
Taréja dosciento cinco canqque'fave an'biamba pa Harán canqqueni.
